01.1Purpose, thesis, and architecture verdict

This specification defines the target architecture and proof obligations for replacing TRIAD's legacy deterministic feature/signal authority with ORIGIN. The engine's job is narrow: transform causally available canonical market state into deterministic, versioned, fully attributable trade hypotheses. Policy decides; risk authorizes money; execution acts; outcomes measure.

Core thesis. A useful deterministic engine is not the one with the most structure labels. It is the one whose every output is causally reproducible, semantically stable, separately testable, economically attributable, and safe to deny.
Unproved economics. The specification makes a profitable engine testable; it cannot make one profitable by declaration. Promotion depends on costs, queue uncertainty, live fills, trial accounting, and prospective evidence.

01.3Constitutional laws

ORIGIN owns deterministic features, typed structures, reactions, and complete trade hypotheses only.
ORIGIN MUST NOT hold venue credentials, place orders, size notional, select leverage, reserve portfolio risk, or originate fill/outcome truth.
The deterministic control route MUST bypass E03–E06. Intelligence may observe or produce a separately identified treatment decision, but may not mutate the control candidate.
Every structure definition is a versioned falsifiable hypothesis, never an inherited market truth or proof of edge.
BOS, CHOCH, FVG, order-block, and reclaim hypotheses begin as independent capsules with separate denominators.
Every persistent occurrence has one stable identity across packets, retries, TTL checks, geometry revisions, restarts, replay, and failover.
Structure, reaction, hypothesis, cluster, candidate, decision, reservation, authorization, command, order, fill, campaign, and outcome identities are distinct.
Source event, transaction, receipt, normalization, watermark, knowledge, evaluation, and publication times MUST remain distinct.
No confirmed output may be available before every dependency was received and its watermark completed.
Confirmed outputs MUST be prefix invariant: future events cannot alter already-confirmed history.
Every lifecycle transition is append-only; terminal states are absorbing unless a new contract explicitly defines a corrective successor event.
Price geometry and boundary comparisons use integer ticks bound to an instrument-metadata revision; quantity uses integer step units.
Floating point MUST NOT determine identity, boundary crossing, side correctness, venue validity, reservation arithmetic, or quantity conservation.
Directional-change swing, centered fractal, rolling extreme, equal level, and session level are different types and may not be aliased to generic swing.
Forming-bar observations are provisional and physically excluded from the confirmed money-authority lane.
Missing, stale, gapped, unverified, or unsupported data is an honest null or named invalid state, never zero or neutral.
Long and short rules are exact algebraic mirrors unless an asymmetric hypothesis is separately preregistered.
Structure geometry MUST NOT read E08 sizing, leverage, portfolio, or stop-floor policy.
ORIGIN emits natural invalidation and target geometry. E08 may deny, size, or tighten protection under a separate policy; it may not widen natural invalidation or redefine the structure.
Formula version plus parameter digest identifies one semantic detector instance; any semantic parameter change creates a new trial identity.
Correlated hypotheses from one occurrence carry one opportunity_cluster_id; E07 arbitrates and may not count aliases as votes.
No hard-coded detector or configuration override may bypass the signed policy registry.
Shadow, control, treatment, paper-research, and money populations remain physically and analytically separable.
Every funnel denominator is reported independently: structures, reactions, candidates, decisions, reservations, authorizations, orders, fills, and campaigns.
A touch, bar high/low, or book cross is never treated as proof of a maker fill.
Every trial—including failed, abandoned, renamed, sliced, and agent-generated variants—MUST be registered before result access.
No detector, cost model, threshold, universe, or exit rule may mutate during a frozen evidence window.
Only an active, scoped, non-expired producer lease with a monotonically increasing fencing token may cross into money authority.
Contract, config, build, detector, parameter, instrument-map, fee, risk, and universe digests attest to one approved bundle.
Rollback revokes entry authority, preserves risk-reducing exits, reconciles orders/positions/protection/reservations, and preserves evidence.
Normal entries and exits use post-only maker mechanics; no silent IOC, GTC, price-match, market, or crossing fallback is permitted.
Authorized taker behavior is restricted to an E09-owned emergency escape that can only reduce verified exposure.
Every emergency escape is separately authorized, attributed, measured, and reconciled; any taker entry, add, or reversal is a severity-one breach.
Learning may publish signed governed artifacts, but may not mutate live detectors or policy directly.
MCP is read-only: it may inspect, replay, compare, and propose, but never arm, place, cancel, flatten, enable, or reset.

01.9Data, time, identity, and quality invariants

Required clocks

source_event_time, exchange_transaction_time where supplied, received_at, received_monotonic_ns, normalized_at, watermark_completed_at, knowledge_at, evaluated_at, and published_at.

origin_event_time ≤ confirmation_event_time
knowledge_at ≥ max(all dependency received_at, watermark_completed_at)
published_at ≥ knowledge_at

Semantic TTL uses event time. Operational freshness uses receipt and knowledge time. Recovered facts retain their real recovery availability; they are never backdated. Data without original receipt/watermark evidence is labeled approximate and cannot pass exact-live-replay certification.

Identity chain

source_event_id → level_id → structure_id → reaction_id → hypothesis_id
→ opportunity_cluster_id → candidate_id → decision_id → reservation_id
→ execution_authorization_id → execution_command_id → order_id → fill_id
→ position_id / campaign_id → outcome_id

Canonical structure identity

structure_id = hash(
  identity_schema_version,
  canonical_instrument_id,
  venue_model,
  structure_kind,
  semantic_instance_id,
  direction,
  immutable_occurrence_source_ids,
  original_geometry_digest
)

original_geometry_digest freezes at first confirmation. Later append-only geometry revisions retain the same structure_id. Mutable/current geometry is never rehashed into a false new occurrence.

Partition quality

INIT → SYNCING → READY → DEGRADED | GAPPED | STALE → RESYNCING → READY. New money-eligible structures require every mandatory dependency to be READY. A gap blocks new transitions and withdraws affected candidates with a named reason; risk-reducing exits remain available.

01.10Risk, execution, and emergency escape boundary

Normal path

  • Entries and ordinary exits: explicit-price LIMIT with timeInForce=GTX.
  • No automatic fallthrough to GTC, IOC, market, price-match, or crossing.
  • A GTX reject, expiry, or would-cross modification causes a new policy evaluation; it never silently changes liquidity role.
  • Every reprice is a new attempt under the same economic hypothesis and records queue-priority loss.

Emergency escape hierarchy

  1. Tier 0: maker escape remains active while the ratified urgency budget allows.
  2. Tier 1: aggressive IOC limit with explicit worst acceptable price; residual exposure remains visible and is reconciled.
  3. Tier 2: market exit only if a separately ratified policy explicitly prefers exposure removal over a user-defined slippage ceiling.

E09 owns the state: NORMAL_PROTECTED → PROTECTION_DEGRADED → MAKER_ESCAPE_ACTIVE → EMERGENCY_ELIGIBLE → TAKER_REDUCING → RECONCILING → FLAT. Quantity derives from venue-reconciled exposure. One-way and hedge modes use distinct validated paths. Unknown submission status blocks duplicate resubmission until reconciliation proves the first command absent.

Severity-one invariants. Emergency entry, exposure increase, direction reversal, stale producer acceptance, unprotected position beyond the ratified deadline, shadow-to-money leakage, or a normal-path taker fill triggers entry halt and rollback handling.

Binance conditional protection

Conditional STOP/TAKE_PROFIT families use the current Algo Service. E09 consumes and persists ALGO_UPDATE as well as regular order events, reconciles open regular and algo orders, and proves that protection remains armed. Acknowledgement alone is not protection truth.

01.11Economic evidence doctrine

Three planes of evidence

Signal / theoretical

Causal opportunity and price-path response before fill modeling. It proves neither queue access nor money EV.

Execution simulated

Conservative, versioned queue/fill/cost bounds. Public L2 cannot reveal exact hypothetical queue position and ordinary depth excludes some liquidity.

Venue-confirmed money

Reconciled orders, fills, fees, funding, protection, positions, and outcomes. This is the authoritative economic plane.

Mandatory study design

  • Immutable preregistration of every trial and parameter family.
  • Chronological outer evaluation with purging and embargo matching dependency/outcome horizons.
  • Campaign/opportunity-cluster sample unit; no duplicate fill-row independence.
  • Actual fees, rebates, funding, slippage, emergency escape cost, and point-in-time venue metadata.
  • Long, short, symbol, capsule, regime, and aggregate results; gross and net separately.
  • Confidence intervals under dependence; parameter-neighborhood stability; cost/fill/latency stress.
  • PBO, Deflated Sharpe, and family-wise multiple-testing control over the complete trial family.
  • An untouched prospective period; any post-result change creates a new trial and resets evidence.
Recommendation, not yet ratified threshold. Candidate economic gates are: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for net EV above zero, DSR probability ≥95%, PBO ≤5%, Romano–Wolf adjusted significance ≤5%, positive locked OOS and prospective net results, and no dominant single symbol/day/campaign. The exact gate and power calculation remain owner/risk decisions and MUST be frozen before the evidence window.

Objective function

Do not optimize universal fill rate. Optimize calibrated net expected value per eligible attempt subject to capacity, adverse-selection, drawdown, tail-loss, and safety constraints. A post-only strategy can improve by refusing toxic fills.

Every SLO receives owner, window, percentile, load condition, error budget, and response action.

01.13Security, secrets, observability, and production posture

  • E09/VGP is the sole keyholder. ORIGIN, replay, research, Learning, intelligence, Relay, and MCP have no venue-write credentials.
  • Replace global live.env sourcing with per-service scoped secret injection; rotate any source-exposed token; block secret material from logs, traces, fixtures, bundles, and reports.
  • Production has one live behavior. Offline replay/simulator binaries and identities cannot load production credentials or acquire producer leases.
  • Every process attests contract/config/build/parameter/instrument/risk/universe digests at startup; mismatch is a named fail-close state.
  • Trace context propagates across logical message envelopes, but trace IDs never determine economic identity.
  • Audit and local safety evidence remain available if NATS, Prometheus, or a remote MCP reader is unavailable.
  • Ingress, money control, and evidence networks use explicit allow rules; default deny; no hidden direct E02→E09 route.

MCP boundary

MCP exposes read-only investigation. Dark or dependency-unavailable families remain honestly unavailable until configured, authenticated, and independently verified. No operator or money verb may be added to the evidence surface.

01.15Reference topology and specification corrections

How this specification interprets the image

  • The image is a useful target-state authority model, not as-built proof.
  • ORIGIN replaces E02 deterministic feature/signal science. It does not replace E00–E01 or E03–E10.
  • The generic NATS/data-contract arrows are logical interfaces. Initial delivery may use the current append-only ledger adapter; a JetStream migration is a separate certified transport change.
  • The “fill rate >98%” target is removed as a universal alpha objective. The replacement is calibrated net EV per eligible attempt with fill-quality and adverse-selection constraints.
  • Average slippage is replaced by distributions and emergency-tail reporting.
  • Execution command authorship is clarified: E08 authorizes; E09 compiles venue commands.
  • Current Binance WebSocket route families and Algo conditional-order behavior are explicit release blockers.
